steps.assistant_text: IDO 7.1 NCC donor finished from the 99.822 NM donor (agent-g run 366, kit CDLII). Edg pool temps are function-wide variables with one uopt colour each, so per-statement pool-slot placement decides registers: appends 2 and 5 write through a pooled Gfx::set0(hi) (one LR, a1; one parameter keeps the frame), the loop's first / last element reads go through curM() (an internal me(this) pool temp puts Arr * in the old-count slot, s3), and the two ref() statements read the element through a static AIter::satD(it.a, it.idx) (no this temp) so the ref() address takes the appends' head slot (s0); -O0 NCC -S maps pool slots to s-registers and was used as a cheap slot oracle.
